Landscape Install

Qualifications

This proposal is based on plans prepared by: Joseph Kelley, ASLA, sheets LS-01 thru LS-04, Dated: November 1, 2024.

Landscape Install

This proposal reflects the plant schedule quantities shown on the plans. Shortages and undersized plant material are common in the landscaping industry due to current market conditions; therefore, height of shrubs per required container size cannot be guaranteed. This proposal may include increased container sizes to meet the requested specifications shown on the plant schedule. An add/deduct price can be provided for an additional cost. Mulch shall be Pine Straw per schedule.

Material Availability

7-gallon shrubs proposed to meet the 24" minimum spec

10' tall, 2" caliper trees proposed to meet minimum spec

Soil Samples & Amendments

Soil testing analysis results will determine if drainage sump gravel or amendments are necessary. Soil testing will be provided at no additional cost to the owner and/or developer. It is more cost effective to add sump gravel or amend soils with fertilizers and nutrients, should results show any deficiencies. These items can be provided for an additional price on “as needed” basis.

Sod Install

Sod shall be unirrigated Bahia. Sod quantities are estimated. The actual quantity used may be different. The contractor may request additional areas for sod to be installed at the same square foot price contracted through this scope of work. A color-out attachment has been provided to show sod areas Juniper has included in this proposal.

Exclusions

This proposal does not include tree protection, topsoil, herbicide, root barrier, or soil remediation.

Substitutions

This proposal includes Agriform as a substitute for the 8-10-8 Fertilizer. Arbor-Brace tree anchoring system may be required depending on the availability of lumber for the 2 X 4 tree staking.


Irrigation Install

Irrigation estimate based on Juniper Design/Build

Water source defined, within the irrigation, as Well/Pump, designed and estimated to produce 35 GPM @ 60 PSI. Pump price based on 230V single Phase availability. Failure to provide this power may result in price change.

Well Quote is valid for 30 days.  Depth of well is estimate. Any changes to well depth due to environmental circumstances may result in additional billing. 1.5 Hp pump to deliver 35 GPM, Drill depth estimated at 80’

Power to the irrigation pump to be provided by others.

Water Use Permit to be provided by others.

Irrigation design and price subject to change based on issuance of WUP.

Juniper Landscaping shall not be liable for wells ability to produce the volume of water required and/or the quality of water.

Location of water source not available at time of estimate.

Desired location of the irrigation controller was not available at time of estimate.

Power to irrigation controller to be provided by others.

All Landscape is hydro-zoned.

Irrigation Main line, valves and lateral lines on irrigation plan are shown in schematic form ONLY.
